title: It folds the wrong way
text: It folds the wrong way. I discovered that to fold this up, you must remove it from the bed altogether. Both parts actually fold in the same way, so you can't just fold it down, as I had thought.

product_metadata.title: Urban Shelf (Red
description: Urban Shelf is a handy storage device designed to hold your essentials on a stable yet easily foldable platform - all smartly held in place with a mattress, sofa or futon. Creates the perfect spot for keeping phones, remotes, keys, small water bottles, eyeglasses, light books and more while in bed. Integrated cord holders ensure gadgets are charged when you wake - eliminates the need to reach on the ground for charger tips. An edge lip keeps items like pocket change/lip balm/mints from falling. The ability to fold quickly adds portability as a key asset. Fits in any bag - which makes it great for travel. Whether at home, hotel, dorm, RV or anywhere else - so long as you have 7" of clearance, Urban Shelf will fit on your side of the bed. Use it for holding chips and dip while watching TV, Urban Shelf easily attaches to many couches. Also doubles as a sturdy iPad, Kindle, Nook, or tablet stand. Viewing angle perfect for tables, counters, airplane trays. Case or not - in portrait/landscape, Urban Shelf is a must have accessory if you watch video or read on your iPad/tablet. (Note: Not intended to hold an ipad/tablet in bedside-shelf mode). Designed and made in Pennsylvania, USA. Urban Shelf will not hold your laptop next to your bed, it is designed only to hold a few light items bedside. Instructions: Push mattress in slightly so you can just see the top edge of your box spring. Position the shelf close as possible to headboard to eliminate bouncing when moving around in bed. Push Urban Shelf all the way in at the base so that it’s very snug against the mattress side wall. Supporting the bottom hinge is key. Use included grip tape on bottom surface to really lock it in place - apply on outer edges close to the bottom hinge. Wall mounting and grip tape application instructions are on website.
